title: Reimmersed - ENTER STRANGE!!!
description: Completely view your world from a new perspective. Weird and cool textures to help elevate your gameplay and confuse your opponents. This pack is an experiment, where AI makes textures using JavaScript and I, a human, splice them and create the pack!
body:
Immerse yourself in a brand new world of Minecraft!

Have you ever wondered what an AI could do when given the prompt to make textures? With this texture pack, I have prompted and spliced AI pictures it made using JavaScript and created a complete pack out of it!

Great for combat and for survival. Funny weapons and fun gameplay enhancements. The lava looks the coolest!
